name: 精致推荐工作台
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished, shippable Chinese desktop web APP mockup for "职来 Agent". It is an evidence-based job recommendation workspace, NOT a marketing landing page. Render one flat, front-on complete desktop screen, 1536 x 1152 landscape, no perspective, no laptop frame. Beautiful commercial product UI with a quiet nearly-white ivory background #f7f8f6, pure white reading cards, fine neutral dividers, forest teal #1c5d4a primary buttons, pale mint selection, warm amber only for uncertainty. Restrained similar quality to Wellfound's clear employer/job hierarchy, Huntr's readable workspace, and Simplify's refined spacing; ORIGINAL composition, no copied logos. Typography modern Chinese sans, crisp generous letterforms, clear 24px job headings, 14px readable body, excellent spacing.
A 208px LIGHT left sidebar, tiny teal brand mark and "职来 Agent", caption "求职工作台", thin line icons. Navigation: "智能推荐" selected with mint rectangle; "总览", "岗位池", "投递台账", "岗位情报库", then lower divider "配置", "审计日志". No avatars, unrelated illustrations, arbitrary numbers, testimonials, or fake match percentages.
Main header "智能推荐", secondary text "看清值得投的理由，也看清要先确认的风险。", primary "寻找匹配岗位" upper right, smaller "刷新". Below a compact neutral summary strip "1 个优先了解 · 1 个先核实 · 1 个未进入推荐" and understated link "全部岗位在岗位池". A clean search/filter row: magnifying glass, "岗位、公司或地点", "全部候选", checkbox "有同团队体验样本".
Two job cards with sophisticated employer initials, not real company logos; all content explicitly illustrative with subtle "演示" tags. First card: "数据产品经理", "示例科技 · 北京", mint badge "优先了解". Second card: "AI 产品经理", "示例云 · 杭州", amber badge "核实后再投".
Each card must include ALL these DECISION INFORMATION regions. (1) overview with salary, eligibility and skill match: first "20,000–26,000 元/月", "已知门槛通过", "已知技能较匹配"; second "薪资未披露", "门槛待核实", "有能力缺口". Small note "提交资格仍需核实". (2) side-by-side "值得了解的理由" and "风险与待确认", a few calm green/check indicators and amber/caution indicators, not gaudy nested boxes. First reasons "技能覆盖 4/4 项" "固定月薪下限达到期望" "北京符合城市选择"; first risk "奖金与总包待核实" "管理文化、稳定性证据不足". Second reasons "需求分析、数据分析相关" "杭州符合城市选择"; second risks "薪资和工时未披露" "AI 项目能力需补充". Small tasteful clickable evidence capsule "依据 1" etc attached to individual reasons. (3) WORK EXPERIENCE all six subdimensions, a light 2-column x 3-row compact grid, never omit: "时间负担" ("9:30–18:30，双休" first; "待核实" second), "工作节奏" ("待核实"), "职责质量" ("数据产品与指标体系" first; "AI 产品需求与用户反馈" second), "管理文化" ("待核实"), "成长性" ("导师反馈与内部培训" first; "待核实" second), "稳定性" ("待核实"). Known and unknown have different typography weight, unknown is quiet but readable. (4) footer disclosure "待遇细项与决策依据" with "9 条来源记录" first, "4 条来源记录" second, a chevron; tiny provenance cue "岗位披露 / 个人经历，保留来源与时间". Primary dark teal "查看原岗位". Keep cards beautiful, balanced, subtly bordered with 14px corners, no thick colored left stripes, no excessively small text, no score meter, no fake certainty. Everything should feel intentionally designed and trustworthy, with fine spacing and sober icon system. Chinese text should be accurately rendered.
Layout C: Keep the same palette and content with two large two-column cards, but more refined compact hierarchy: a thin full-width title band, mint salary/eligibility readout band, reasons and risks as carefully aligned short columns and the six experience attributes as open airy paired rows. Softer mint sidebar, generous outer margins, subtly lifted white cards. All content and both full footers remain visible.
choice_basis: 用户委托自主设计并完整实施，商业化横向卡保持全部决策点并改善扫描
